# Ghost · Autopilot for WhatsApp

> Ghost (v1.8.6) is a 100% on-device Android WhatsApp scheduler and sequential broadcast autopilot. Schedule once: Ghost wakes your phone at the exact minute, opens WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business, types custom {name} messages one by one, taps Send at a natural human pace, and locks the screen.

Ghost operates 100% locally on Android 8.0+ without cloud servers or bulk APIs. It dispatches messages sequentially through a 4-step autonomous device control loop (01 Wakes on Cue, 02 Opens WhatsApp, 03 Sends One by One, 04 Closes WhatsApp) with an instant Volume-Down hardware emergency stop.

## Documentation & Core Sections

- [Ghost Landing Page & Interactive Dashboard](https://ghost.justsimpleapps.online/): Overview of the autonomous Android courier for WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business.
- [How Ghost Works (4-Step Autonomous Control)](https://ghost.justsimpleapps.online/#how-it-works): Step-by-step breakdown of screen wake, chat search, sequential auto-tap send, and screen lock.
- [Core Use Cases (Client Lists & Loved Ones)](https://ghost.justsimpleapps.online/#use-cases): Zero-ban-risk {name} client broadcasts and recurring daily, weekly, and yearly schedules.
- [Inside the App (v1.8.6 Interface Screens)](https://ghost.justsimpleapps.online/#screens): Compose, Live Send, Queue, and Setup screens from the Android app.
